newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki bourse posts record cumulative trade.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki bourse posts record cumulative trade.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange on Tuesday said the annual cumulative trade volume had risen to an all-time high with 30 days left to trade in the year.

"At the end of continuous trading today, the value of share trading from the beginning of the year was 83,094 million markka, which exceeds last year's record trade volume by 74 million markka," the stock exchange said in a statement.
Total share trading in 1995 amounted to 83,019 million markka, the bourse said.
The average daily volume so far this year has been 380 million markka, up from 333 million last year, it said.
